PDF.js / pdfjs-dist version 5.6.205
Mozilla Foundation and contributors
Official project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Usage documentation: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/
Vendored from the installed official pdfjs-dist package.

Core and worker: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.
Fonts, character maps and image decoders have their respective license files
in standard_fonts/, cmaps/ and wasm/.

This viewer supplies PDF bytes from browser-local IndexedDB. The library's
worker, fonts, character maps and decoder assets are served from this directory.
